definitions.edge_stability: min(T448,T453), conservative edge-band transmission; a derived metric only, not a weighted score.
definitions.global_high_dimensional_pareto: non_actionable: all 2688 were non-dominated under the prior high-dimensional formulation, so it cannot select candidates.

P1.definition: fixed total mirror-pair count 6; scan (N_GaN,N_Air)=(1,5),(2,4),(3,3),(4,2),(5,1) in GaN -> stack -> Air direction; defect remains between Bragg regions. This is discrete defect-position/asymmetric-mirror-strength, not per-layer motion.

P2.definition: canonical order and full reversal control only; retain unique sequence hashes; keep within 20-30 TMM structures when expanded.

P3.definition: Explicit C boundary gaps only. ZL-1 effective centers remain constrained by (M+1)L; an independently variable center requires a new topology.

P4.definition: outer/inner/center-adjacent grouped offsets, ±1 nm; no free per-layer sweep.

P5.definition: fully independent per-layer nominal sweep is intentionally not proposed; reserve for tolerance/FDTD validation.
